source.experiment: Driver, D. M. and Seegmiller, H. L., 'Features of Reattaching Turbulent Shear Layer in Divergent Channel Flow,' AIAA Journal, Vol. 23, No. 2, Feb 1985, pp. 163-171.
source.cross_code_check: TMR publishes SA, SST, SST-V, Wilcox2006-klim, K-kL-MEAH2015, EASMko2003-S, K-e-Rt CFD comparisons against this experiment; SA reattachment x/H ~ 6.1, SSTm reattachment x/H ~ 6.50, both bracketing the experimental 6.26 +- 0.10.

mesh_cell_count.description: Total cell count of the 2D backstep mesh
mesh_cell_count.T_good_source: TMR provides nested grids from coarsest 65x65/25x65 (~6k cells) to finest 513x513/193x513 (~390k cells); a wall-resolved (y+~1) RANS of this geometry typically lands ~40-60k cells in 2D. Hand-set midpoint.

final_residual_U.description: Final residual of the momentum equation
final_residual_U.T_good_source: Hand-set; subsonic RANS on this geometry routinely reaches 1e-5 (steady SA) or 1e-4 quasi-steady (SST, which TMR notes does not converge fully steady on this case).

reattachment_length_xH.description: Lower-wall reattachment location measured as x/H at the zero-Cf crossing downstream of the step (x/H = 0 at the step face).
reattachment_length_xH.T_good_source: Driver & Seegmiller 1985 experimental reattachment x/H = 6.26 +- 0.10 (laser oil-flow interferometer, zero-Cf interpolation), quoted verbatim on TMR backstep_val.html. T_good = 0.40 covers the experimental +-0.10 band plus turbulence-model spread (TMR publishes SA at ~6.1 and SSTm at ~6.50, i.e. ~+-0.2 around the experiment). T_bad = 1.20 (~20%) flags the gross under/over-prediction characteristic of mis-tuned turbulence models or mesh-coarse cases.

cp_min_in_recirculation.description: Minimum (most negative) lower-wall Cp inside the separation bubble (over 0 <= x/H <= 6), using the shifted Cp convention where Cp = 0 at x/H ~ 40.
cp_min_in_recirculation.T_good_source: TMR cp.expnew.dat (rev. 2014-02-28) shifted Cp column: minimum = -0.1903 at x/H = 3.0 on the bottom wall. Adjacent points: -0.1883 at x/H=2.0 and -0.1806 at x/H=3.5, so the trough is broad and shallow. T_good = 0.025 (~13% of |gt|) covers the experimental scatter and turbulence-model variation in recirculation pressure. T_bad = 0.080 (~42%) flags either a missed bubble (Cp too flat) or the wrong shift convention.

cf_recovery_at_xH_20.description: Lower-wall skin-friction coefficient Cf at x/H = 20 in the post-reattachment recovery region, normalised by 0.5 rho_inf U_ref^2.
cf_recovery_at_xH_20.T_good_source: TMR cf.exp.dat (rev. 2015-10-17) at x/H = 20.196: Cf = 2.02e-3 +- 0.141e-3 (1-sigma experimental error). Adjacent points 16.196 -> 1.91e-3, 24.136 -> 2.04e-3 confirm the value plateaus to ~2.0e-3 in the recovery region. T_good = 4e-4 (~20% of gt) covers experimental error band plus turbulence-model recovery-rate scatter. T_bad = 1.2e-3 flags failure to recover (Cf still negative or near-zero) which would indicate the agent never reached steady recovery downstream.
